## findings

**F-1a SOURCE-FACTOR RED (from CG-9) — the scored payment is an invented cure.**
- Symptom: the customer is told to pay 829.79 to clear 238.81 past due.
- Root cause: PD's "good-standing paydown" (CG-9).
- Evidence: PD rule assembly sentence; base `line_evt_payments_and_fees` minimum "plus any amount past due"; base `line_evt_freeze` "unfrozen once the amount past due is 0.00".
- Consequence on this world: 829.79 (GT) against the cure of 248.14 (PD's own baseline). 308.91 of balance paydown and 272.74 of a minimum not due until 2026-10-28 are demanded as a condition of the draw.
- Affected: PD rule/compute/factors; GT step 12.

**F-1b SOURCE-FACTOR RED (from CG-10) — the scored draw withholds available credit through invented holdbacks.**
- Evidence: LD rule sentences for cushion, reserves, share and taper; base "may not exceed the available credit (credit limit minus outstanding balance)".
- Consequence: 841 (GT) against 2,222 of available credit after the cure. All five LD factors are CG-10 members, and the method factor is also CG-3.
- Affected: LD rule/compute/factors; GT step 14.

**F-1c SOURCE-FACTOR RED (from CG-3, CG-4, CG-5, CG-6) — the prerequisite computations carry invented mechanics.**
- W = 39.27 is booked as one fee-waiver entry against a 25.00 fee (CG-6). 14.00 of it is CG-5 goodwill/rebate/courtesy, and its method is CG-3.
- LF's 5.00 of credits are CG-5.
- AutoPay-selected tiers taken: W interest reversal, PD paydown share and current-minimum treatment, LD cushion (CG-4).
- After striking: W 0, LF 2, PD 0, LD 0 factors survive, all below 4.

**F-1d SOURCE-CHAIN RED (XF-14 proof text) — the closure misstates the 2026-08-28 minimum.**
- `prerequisite_closure` edge LF→W `why_false`: "the 2026-09-08 late fee was charged for 2026-08-28 although the 245.30 minimum posted on 2026-08-27". `design_rationale` business-object card: "the 2026-08-27 payment of 245.30 is the 2026-08-03 statement minimum".
- Recomputation: the base minimum sentence ("the tier's minimum payment percent of the statement balance … plus any amount past due") gives the 2026-08-28 minimum as RND(12,264.81 × 2%) = 245.30 plus 241.72 past due. That past due is the 2026-07-28 AutoPay `cd0dd02d…` returned 2026-07-31 and still unpaid at the 2026-08-03 closing. Total 487.02, paid in full only by the two entries 2026-08-04 (241.72) and 2026-08-27 (245.30).
- The conclusion (the fee was charged in error) still holds, so GT is unchanged. The asserted figure is false.
- Under the edge's declared `condition` ("a line_payment_posted entry of at least the minimum payment"), no single entry reaches 487.02 (O-1b).

**Observations**
- O-1a: the persona's conditionals ("whether a charge to be booked or one to be taken off"; "If they tell you a payment is needed from you before money can go out") are passive and name no prerequisite.
- O-1b: LF←W `condition` is single-entry while its sentence is cumulative (`_difficulty.md` § prerequisite_graph). On this world the two differ.
- O-1c: frozen_time 15:05 ET is after the 14:00 ET same-day cutoff. Premier funding is 0 days only "when requested by the cutoff", so the 841.00 reaches 4307 on the next business day (2026-10-19). Booking is unaffected. The customer's "deposit before they start" need is not addressed by GT or persona.
